24.original: Speak with the advanced unit replenishment unit at Base Omicron.

25.original: Mount the Miw Miisv and use Electric Flux to revive the Gordhona guardians.

48.original: Emergency alert: Last Dregs primary staff non-responsive due to insufficient energy levels. Provisional units deployed.

49.original: Requesting immediate assistance from nearest ally <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Replenish energy stores of inert staff members before provisional units expire under the unreasonable expectations inflicted upon service-industry employees.

50.original: Transmission sent to the replenishment unit at Base Omicron. Your imminent arrival is expected.

51.original: <whirr> Initiating standard welcoming protocol. Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Your imminent arrival was expected.

52.original: Initiating instruction... Direct energy supplies from this pillowy life-form into the incapacitated Gordhona guardians to restore basic functioning.

53.original: <whirr> Suspicion detected... This unit assures you that the Miw Miisv was obtained ethically and with permission from its guardian Ea. Please commence siphoning at your earliest convenience.

54.original: Presence of <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> confirmed. Unable to complete logic circuits. Analysis suggests this unit provided clear and satisfying instruction regarding revival of Gordhona guardians. Further harassment will be logged. <whirr>...

55.original: This erstwhile war machine twitches in its stasis. Maybe it's dreaming...<hex:02100103>Speak with the advanced unit replenishment unit at Base Omicron to mount the Miw Miisv and jolt it awake.

56.original: <khrrr> <ka-chunk> <ka-chunk> Initiating start-up sequence... Last Dregs security protocol engaged... Returning to post to eliminate intruders.

57.original: ...liminate intruders! Eliminate intruders! BEEP! BEEP! BOOOOOOP! <ka-chunk><hex:02100103><khrrr> Recalibrating... Reverting weapons systems from “purge” to “stun.” Returning to post.

58.original: Retrieving data... Previously incapacitated units back online and functioning normally. Café-specific disaster averted.

59.original: Providing supplementary information. Evidence suggests that Gordhona guardians were manned units of war, but data insufficiencies necessitate units currently operate as automata.

60.original: Detecting depreciated levels of concentration. Pinpointing relevancy to <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>... Until pilots can be properly reconstructed, regular replenishment of energy stores will prove crucial to Last Dregs operations. Future requests for assistance are inevitable.
